name: Spring Vegetable Soup
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: one and a half quarts of soup stock
ingredients.originalText: one and a half quarts of soup stock

instructions.text: Put in a stewpan the lettuce, onion, parsley and butter, with one pint of water, and let them simmer till tender.
When done, strain off the vegetables, and put two-thirds of the liquor with the stock.
Beat up the yolks of the eggs with the other third, toss it over the fire.
At the moment of serving add this with the vegetables to the strained-off soup.

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put in a stewpan the lettuce, onion, parsley and butter, with one pint of water, and let them simmer till tender.
2. Season with salt and pepper.
3. When done, strain off the vegetables, and put two-thirds of the liquor with the stock.
4. Beat up the yolks of the eggs with the other third, toss it over the fire.
5. At the moment of serving add this with the vegetables to the strained-off soup.
